title: The invoice reaches QuickBooks under the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company that you can sign in to.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, already linked to a QuickBooks customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. In QuickBooks, open the invoice with work order 1's invoice number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 4:

  • The QuickBooks invoice's customer is customer B's linked QuickBooks customer.
  • Its total equals the ShopView invoice total.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12319 (Story 17, QuickBooks sync)

  • S17-R1: “The invoice is sent to QuickBooks with the Bill To as its customer.”
  • Feature Overview, Integrations: “QuickBooks Online: the invoice is sent under the Bill To.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The Bill To owns the receivable: payment terms and due date, credit limit, Credit Hold, Customer PO and "PO is required", deposits, payments, credits, the QuickBooks invoice customer, IBS, the portal Pay button and the invoice email.”
